title: DataLock
description: DRAFT until ADR 0061 is Accepted (F3-WO4). ADR 0061 D10: the data lock of a process revision, derived from the revision's record SHAs and method ids and versions and from the F1 registry, never stored in the revision. `data_lock_sha256` is the SHA-256 of the lock's canonical JSON (`document_sha256`). `components` keep revision order with unique ids; `parameter_sets` are ascending and unique; `methods` are sorted by (substream, method, version key); the keys of `method_options` are among the methods' ids. Orders and the key rule a JSON Schema cannot state are `openflowsheet.records.lock.build_lock`'s. Rights never enter the lock (Q9.A2).

components.description: The revision's components in revision order: the component id and the SHA of the record it is bound to.

parameter_sets.description: The SHAs of the parameter-set records the revision uses, ascending.

methods.description: The property methods bound per substream, each with the `implementation_sha256` of its registered descriptor (ADR 0060 D3: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of [descriptor_sha256, self_sha256]).

method_options.description: The options of each locked method, by method id.
